analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical landscape between Thailand and Cambodia in 2016. It identifies key stakeholders such as government leaders, military forces, and diplomatic missions who drive official policy, alongside media outlets, analysts, and activist groups who shape and propagate public opinion on social media regarding border frictions and national sovereignty.
simulation_requirement: predict thai vs cambodia relationship in 2016
